defs.meaning: （计算机的）信息收发，电子邮件的发送和处理
发送；报信（message 的现在分词）

examples.en: Messaging allows real-time communication by keyboard with up to five people at any one time.
examples.zh: 信息的发送能使最多五个人同时通过键盘进行实时交流。

examples.en: I think text messaging actually sort of has to do with your age.
examples.zh: 我觉得发短信实际上和你的年龄也有一定的关系。

examples.en: Yeah, I think text-messaging actually sort of has to do with your age.
examples.zh: 是的，我觉得发短信实际上和你的年龄有关。

synonyms.meaning: 消息传送；通知；信息传送
